verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs describe an AR aging report under Revenue → AR aging. It groups each customer's unpaid invoices into Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 91+ day buckets, shows what's overdue by customer and tracks unapplied payments. Per-customer receivables are also exposed through MCP customer and invoice tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AR aging report.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: Each customer's unpaid invoices are grouped into Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 91+ days
it shows what's overdue by customer, finds the payments that most likely pay your open invoices, and flags the receivables that need attention before you close the month.
